# TopologyAwareScheduling

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A scheduling method that maps quantum operations onto network nodes based on the underlying topology to reduce communication distance. Essential for minimizing end-to-end latency in TCC systems, as it aligns computation with physical interconnect structure.
